title: Sunny and Cocoa
moral: Helping others and being kind makes the journey better.

scenes.summary: Sunny rides her horse Cocoa across the land looking for a home.
scenes.text: Sunny rode her little brown horse Cocoa across the wide land. She wore a soft hat and red scarf and had a plan to find a home at Cottonwood Bend.
scenes.image_prompt: young cowgirl riding horse across wide grassy land with blue sky, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Sunny finds an open gate that could cause trouble for animals.
scenes.text: Sunny saw a gate left open near a ranch. She knew animals could wander away if it stayed open.
scenes.image_prompt: open wooden gate with sheep nearby and girl looking concerned, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Sunny travels carefully, crossing land and water while guiding Cocoa.
scenes.text: Sunny rode across fields and crossed a creek slowly. She guided Cocoa carefully step by step and stayed calm when things got tricky.
scenes.image_prompt: girl guiding horse across creek with stepping stones, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Sunny helps close the gate and earns kindness from others.
scenes.text: Sunny worked hard to close the gate and fixed it. Mrs Juniper thanked her and gave her food and rest.
scenes.image_prompt: girl fixing wooden gate with ranch lady smiling nearby, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Sunny reaches Cottonwood Bend and feels she has found a safe home.
scenes.text: Sunny reached Cottonwood Bend with trees and a river. She rested happily with Cocoa and felt safe and thankful.
scenes.image_prompt: girl resting under trees beside river with horse at sunset, peaceful colorful cartoon children's book style

story: Sunny rode her little brown horse Cocoa across the wide land. She wore a soft hat and red scarf and had a plan to find a home at Cottonwood Bend. Sunny saw a gate left open near a ranch. She knew animals could wander away if it stayed open. Sunny rode across fields and crossed a creek slowly. She guided Cocoa carefully step by step and stayed calm when things got tricky. Sunny worked hard to close the gate and fixed it. Mrs Juniper thanked her and gave her food and rest. Sunny reached Cottonwood Bend with trees and a river. She rested happily with Cocoa and felt safe and thankful.
